user.title: New OORT instance
user.description: An instance weights the rooms of one HVAC zone. Add its rooms and people after creating it.

data_description.name: Used in entity IDs, e.g. "Home" gives sensor.oort_home_temperature.

defaults.name: Defaults
defaults.description: Times are in minutes. Rooms can override the taus and weights.

data_description.tau_deactivate: How fast an inactive room fades out. 0 = instantly.
data_description.tau_dropout: How fast a room fades out when its temperature sensor is unavailable. 0 = instantly.
data_description.stale_limit: How long a room's last reading is still used after its temperature sensor drops out.

defaults.name: Defaults

error.tau_not_positive: Person and occupancy taus must be greater than 0.
error.tau_negative: Deactivate and dropout taus can't be negative.
error.base_weight_not_positive: The unoccupied weight must be greater than 0.
error.stale_limit_not_positive: The stale temperature limit must be greater than 0.

data_description.occupancy_sensors: The room counts as occupied while any of these is on.
data_description.occupancy_template: When true, the room also counts as occupied.
data_description.active_template: When false, the room is left out and its weight fades to 0.

no_occupancy_source.description: In the OORT instance "{instance}", these rooms have no occupancy sensors or occupancy template, and the instance has no people: {rooms}. They will always use the unoccupied weight. Add people to the instance, or occupancy sensors or a template to these rooms.
